item.title: Judge upholds $10M jury award for NN teacher shot by first-grader
item.description: NEWPORT NEWS, Va. (WAVY) — Following a November jury verdict that awarded former elementary school teacher Abigail Zwerner $10 million, a judge denied motions Friday seeking to overturn it. Zwerner was shot in her first-grade classroom in January 2023 by a 6-year-old student. Former assistant principal Ebony Parker was working the day Zwerner was shot. [...]

item.title: About 9,700 Dominion customers in region lost power during storm
item.description: HAMPTON ROADS, Va. (WAVY) — Dominion Energy said nearly 10,000 of its customers across Hampton Roads and northeastern North Carolina lost power during the winter storm that hit the region Saturday. Two spots hit the hardest were Norfolk and the Outer Banks. There were 3,600 Dominion Energy customers without power at one point in Norfolk, [...]

item.title: Child pulled from retention pond in Norfolk apartment complex
item.description: A child was pulled from a retention pond behind an apartment complex off Sellger Drive in Norfolk shortly after 2 p.m. Sunday, officials said.

item.title: Former Cape Henry Collegiate student arrested, school official says
item.description: VIRGINIA BEACH, Va. (WAVY) — Families at Cape Henry Collegiate were notified Sunday after a former student was arrested for making threats against the school, a staff member and the school's principal, a school official said. School officials say the threats were sent via email. The suspect attended the school more than a decade ago [...]

item.title: Hazardous weather leads to closures, delays across Hampton Roads
item.description: Based on the current forecast for the weekend, with Super Doppler 10 Meteorologists predicting a 100% chance of snow for the WAVY viewing area, some schools, churches, and organizations made an early decision to close - or cancel events and services.
